[[Category:Facility]]

The Customer Support Center (commonly called csc for short) is a facility created in the 1.7.0 [[Updates | Update]]. It is a support facility for your retail store(s). It directly affects your retail reputation, which affects your retail demand per hour. 

Customer support centers provide a range of customer services to assist customers in making cost-effective and correct use of a product. It includes assistance in planning, installation, training, troubleshooting, maintenance, upgrading, and disposal of a product.

For more info on retail facilities, please see the [[Retail]] page.
